plain.li: I set out two bowls this morning without thinking. {OTHER_nameDef} has been gone a day.
{OTHER_nameDef}'s side of the bed is cold. I can't make myself sleep on it.
I keep saving things up to tell {OTHER_nameDef}. Then I remember.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made this place home. I don't know what it is now.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. I don't want to talk about it.

cheerful.li: Everyone keeps waiting for me to make a joke about it. I haven't got one. {OTHER_nameDef} would have.

gloomy.li: Everything I had, I had with {OTHER_nameDef}. Now I don't.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died today. I have been told to rest. I keep working instead.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: lost a child
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has had a hardness about {PAWN_objective} since {OTHER} died.

plain.li: A parent shouldn't outlive a child. {OTHER_nameDef} was mine, and I have.
I folded {OTHER_nameDef}'s clothes today. It took most of the afternoon.
People keep telling me they're sorry about {OTHER_nameDef}. I nod. I can't do much else.

warm.li: I keep seeing {OTHER_nameDef} small, running ahead of me. I hope someone carries {OTHER_objective} now.

blunt.li: My child is dead. {OTHER_nameDef}. Leave me be.

gloomy.li: Whatever I was going to be, after {OTHER_nameDef}, I'm not going to be it now.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is gone. I find I can't feel my hands properly. That will pass, I'm told.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: lost family young
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has clung to the grown-ups since {OTHER} died.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} isn't coming back. The grown-ups keep saying it like I didn't hear the first time.
I slept in {OTHER_nameDef}'s blanket last night. It still smells right.
Somebody else walked me to bed tonight. It should have been {OTHER_nameDef}.

warm.li: I put flowers where we buried {OTHER_nameDef}. The yellow ones, because they were {OTHER_possessive} favourite.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died. I don't want to play today.

cheerful.li: I'm trying to be brave about {OTHER_nameDef}. Brave is what {OTHER_pronoun} always called me.

gloomy.li: Everybody dies. I know that now. {OTHER_nameDef} did.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: lost family
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has held the rest of {PAWN_possessive} people closer since {OTHER} died.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is gone, and I'm the one the others look to now. I didn't ask for that.
I found myself telling the young ones one of {OTHER_nameDef}'s old stories. I got most of it right.
We buried {OTHER_nameDef}. I kept {OTHER_possessive} knife. It's the only thing I could carry.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} would want us to look after each other. So I will.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died. We go on. That's what {OTHER_pronoun} taught me.

gloomy.li: One less of us. There were never many to begin with. Goodbye, {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has died. The family is smaller. I will keep what is left of it together.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: lost a friend and closed up
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has let fewer people close since {OTHER} died.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died. That's what comes of getting attached to people out here.
I liked {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll be more careful about liking people.
The others are gathering to talk about {OTHER_nameDef}. I went for a walk instead.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. I'm not going through that again.

gloomy.li: Everyone I let in ends up like {OTHER_nameDef}. I'll stop letting them in.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was useful to have around, and good company. A loss on both counts.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is gone. The work went on today as if nothing happened, and I hated it for that.
I walked past {OTHER_nameDef}'s spot at the table three times before I sat down somewhere else.
{OTHER_nameDef} owed me a game of horseshoes. I'll never collect.

warm.li: I hope {OTHER_nameDef} knew how glad I was of {OTHER_objective}. I think {OTHER_pronoun} did.

blunt.li: Lost {OTHER_nameDef} today. Good friend. Bad day.

cheerful.li: [persona:joker] {OTHER_nameDef} laughed at all my worst jokes. I told one at the grave. Nobody laughed.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died. I find I mind more than I expected to.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: lost their animal
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has kept the other animals at arm's length since {LABEL} died.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: lost the colony's leader
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has felt the colony stand less steady since {OTHER}, who spoke for it, died.
